Return molecules reported in document CHEMBL1150404. Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
